body:
## Problem

Claude Code agents can silently bypass git hooks by running git commit with the hook-skip flag. This disables pre-commit, commit-msg, and pre-push hooks — the same hooks that enforce linting, type-checking, and commit message conventions.

## Solution

Create `.claude/settings.json` with [`block-no-verify@1.1.2`](https://github.com/tupe12334/block-no-verify) as a `PreToolUse` Bash hook. It reads `tool_input.command` from the Claude Code hook stdin payload, detects the hook-bypass flag across all git subcommands, and exits 2 to block.

The existing `.claude/skills` are unchanged.

---

_Disclosure: I am the author and maintainer of `block-no-verify`._
title: feat: add block-no-verify PreToolUse hook to protect git hooks
